items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: Zoo Robertson, he's one guy that wanted to take me with the 101 Ranch I remember. He told the man that I have a trumpet player for her.

ctx.x: The slide would work, I guess, is a little bit. Did you know Zoo Robertson?

Very good. Zoo Robertson, he's one guy that wanted to take me with the 101 Ranch I remember. He told the man that I have a trumpet player for her. And the man sent two tickets. Well, I'm young and I told my mother about it. My mother wouldn't let me go. She wouldn't let me go. So, he had to send the tickets back. Is that sort of a Wild West show or like circuses?
That's right, along them kind of circuses.
